correctness.rationale: Exact Gale-evenness enumeration of all polytope facets and perfect pairings gives all double faces. All ten complete simplicial Hasse graphs are topologically checked for acyclicity under a specified matching. Exact signed Morse chain projections yield integral boundary matrices with Smith factors listed in RESULT; an independent raw simplicial mod-two rank check agrees for every parameter. The proof covers only m=7..16 and asserts no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: This is the natural consecutive ten-member finite classification from the smallest six-dimensional cyclic polytope through the first order-five torsion in its double. The successive even parameters yield distinct integral torsion orders 2,3,4,5 and substantial free homology; this is not a routine re-expression of the cited connectivity theorem or an arbitrary unmotivated graph slice.
